summary: Veridian v7 iteration test — Receipt link security, Reviewer Assignment, Portfolio Heatmap, and Email Branding. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_v7_security_assignment_map.py with 11 tests — ALL PASS (receipt 403 w/o token, 200 w/ SSE-emitted token, 403 w/ tampered token; claim sets assigned_to, list_submissions reflects it, second reviewer gets 409, release clears; /api/portfolio/map 401 w/o auth and returns points with lat/lon/composite/address/sum_insured when authed; OTP request-otp returns 200 with delivery_delayed warning while Resend is rate-limited; backend log shows receipt email path executed without error). Also re-ran regression: test_v6_upgrade.py (10/10 after adjusting test_receipt_pdf_public_no_scores to expect 403 since receipt is now token-gated) + backend_test.py (17/17). Total backend 38/38 pass. Frontend: /submit portal fully works — full E2E form submission (submitter-name/email + policy-address-0/year-0/sum-0), Run Risk Analysis, Submission Received screen, and download-receipt-button href correctly contains ?token=... and downloads a valid application/pdf (HTTP 200). CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: Dashboard.jsx (/insights) crashes on render with ReferenceError: mapPoints is not defined — the JSX at line 138 references `mapPoints` but the variable is never declared and /api/portfolio/map is never fetched from the useEffect (line 34-41 only fetches /submissions and /portfolio/overview). This crash triggers ErrorBoundary and renders 'Something went wrong', blocking: (a) Portfolio Risk Heatmap panel, (b) inbox rendering entirely (no rows, no claim-{id} buttons), (c) all regression flows on the dashboard, (d) navigation into submission detail pages via inbox rows. Because the inbox never renders, Submission Detail claim-button / release-button / assignee-badge could not be UI-tested end-to-end; backend claim/release for those testids works (verified via API in test_v7). Receipt security and email branding require no additional main-agent action.

action_items: FIX Dashboard.jsx: add `const [mapPoints, setMapPoints] = useState([])` and include `api.get('/portfolio/map')` in the initial Promise.all, setting setMapPoints(m.data.points). This unblocks the entire /insights page (heatmap + inbox + claim + detail nav).

After fix, re-verify: (a) Leaflet [data-testid=portfolio-map] with colored circleMarkers + Low/Moderate/High legend, (b) inbox rows show claim-{submission_id} buttons that assign via toast + 'You', (c) submission detail claim-button -> assignee-badge + release-button flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx line 138 uses undeclared `mapPoints` — this is a hard compile-time-should-have-been-caught issue that made it to production. Consider enabling `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` and `no-undef` in ESLint strict mode; also add an ErrorBoundary reporting hook so the crash surfaces in dev logs rather than only in the browser.

Receipt token: `make_receipt_token` uses HMAC with 24h TTL — good. Consider also binding the token to the submitter email or IP for stronger defense; current design permits anyone with the URL to download for 24h, which is acceptable but should be documented (matches an email-link security model).
claim_submission: idempotent claim by same user returns 200 (verified). Response body could include the assignee_display or last_assigned_at for UI to render 'Handled by you since X'.
Dashboard useEffect should have granular error handling — currently one failed API in Promise.all leaves state undefined and can cascade to render errors.

rca of the issue: Dashboard.jsx was updated in this iteration to add the Portfolio Heatmap panel (line 132-145). The JSX correctly references `mapPoints.length` and passes `mapPoints` to <PortfolioMap>, but the developer forgot to (1) declare `const [mapPoints, setMapPoints] = useState([])`, and (2) fetch `/api/portfolio/map` in the mount useEffect. The variable is therefore undefined at render time, throwing ReferenceError and tripping the ErrorBoundary. Reproduction: (1) authenticate (inject veridian_token cookie), (2) navigate to /insights — the branded 'Something went wrong' screen appears immediately. Mitigation: add `const [mapPoints, setMapPoints] = useState([])` near line 20 and change the Promise.all to `const [s, o, m] = await Promise.all([api.get('/submissions'), api.get('/portfolio/overview'), api.get('/portfolio/map')]); setSubs(s.data); setOverview(o.data); setMapPoints(m.data.points || []);`. Backend endpoint is already working (verified: returns {points: [...]} with 22+ points).
